items.text:
I didn't like this game much. To much bureaucracy. I couldn't figure out why I kept getting jumped by guards and getting fines. Also the UI is so awful.

When I saw the trailers it looked like a fun dungeon raid simulator type deal, where the dungeons are space hulks. In reality it's more like a minimum wage job.

I refunded.
items.text_zh:
我不太喜欢这个游戏。官僚主义太多了。我搞不懂为什么我总是被警卫扑倒还被罚款。而且用户界面太糟糕了。

当我看到预告片时，它看起来像是一个有趣的地牢突袭模拟器类型的东西，地牢就是太空废船。实际上它更像是一份最低工资的工作。

我退款了。

observations.description: 不明白为何总被守卫攻击并罚款
observations.evidence: I couldn't figure out why I kept getting jumped by guards and getting fines.
